gaps: Every breath-one ignition is a move made toward a counterpart and exposed to it: a lot offered, a hostage handed over, a gift dropped, a promise spoken in front of others. Sharpening Lot you can lose against the reported silent trade produced an ignition with no exposed move at all, each step retractable until the last, and behind it a family that abolishes the first move rather than shrinking it. This produced the changed question for breath two: which ignitions shrink the first move and which abolish it, and who can strike each. Mutual embarrassment from the territory pointer split under pressure: embarrassment discovered afterward is blackmail, not an ignition, and only the transgression committed jointly at the first act survived, as Sin in common.
accepted: Lot you can lose: the good is cut to a piece small enough that losing it falls below the threshold of grievance, as a freight broker gives a new carrier one load, a restaurant orders one case, a magazine buys one story; the carrier is divisibility, the first move is safe because the worst case is a write-off and not a wound, and the residue is a ladder, since the cooperation can grow only one rung per successful lot and the trial price, set as a loss-leader, must rise later and reads as betrayal when it does; adjacent to cooperation-mechanisms' sequential milestones, which need an agreed plan, this needs none, and what the lot proves is only the lot, which is why salted mines work.

Hostage before the ask: one party hands over, unrequested, something the other can destroy but not use, as a software vendor deposits its source in escrow before the customer thought to require it or a contractor posts a bond nobody demanded; the carrier is Schelling's asymmetry, precious to the giver and worthless to the holder, the first move is safe because it costs nothing if the other cooperates and says what words cannot, and the residue is that the holder keeps a permanent option to destroy and the cooperation cannot grow past the hostage's value without a second hostage; not collateral demanded, which is a term, and not cooperation-mechanisms' retained hostages, which steady a cooperation already running; here the unasked giving is the whole signal.

Gift already eaten: one party delivers something the other has consumed before it could decide whether to accept, as a produce broker drops a case of stone fruit at a restaurant's back door on a Friday or the drug company's lunch is on the table before the clinic is asked; the carrier is a good whose acceptance is performed by its arrival, the first move is safe because it is sized to what the giver can lose, and the residue is a debt in an unpriced currency that the giver may name later and the receiver can never fully close; adjacent to cooperation-mechanisms' recursive gift exchange, which is the running loop, this is the unrefusable first turn, and its power is that no price was said.

Enemy at both doors: a third party whose harm falls on both makes defection between them costlier than cooperation, as two shipping lines form a conference against a third, two restaurants co-fund a street festival against the mall, two firms share one lawyer against a regulator; the carrier is an adversary that exploits any gap between the pair, the first move is safe because the enemy punishes non-cooperation more than the partner could, and the residue is that the cooperation is indexed to the enemy, has no floor when the enemy is gone, and each partner has taught the other how it fights; one side can counterfeit this by inventing the enemy, and then the ignition carries the probe's residue.

Summoned witness: one party makes its promise in front of people who will remember, as a shipbroker closes on the exchange floor by a word other brokers hear, a founder announces a partnership at the trade show before the paper is signed, a contributor's pledge sits in a public issue tracker; the carrier is an audience whose memory the promiser cannot edit, the first move is safe for the counterpart because breaking the promise now costs the promiser its other relationships, and the residue is that the promise freezes in the form the audience heard, so renegotiation looks like breach and the parties keep bad terms to avoid the look of it; unlike cooperation-mechanisms' reputation legible to future partners, which is stock accumulated over time, the witness is summoned at the first move and one side can summon it alone.

Sin in common: the first joint act is a transgression both commit, as two salespeople split a territory the company forbids them to split, two contractors on one site share a crew off the books, two prisoners hold one hidden phone; the carrier is a rule both break in the same act, the first move is safe because each becomes a witness against the other in the same instant, and the residue is that the cooperation can never be made public, expires with the secret's statute, and each partner keeps a knife; not mutual embarrassment discovered afterward, which is blackmail, and not the shared enemy, which stands outside the pair.

Wager that needs a partner: two parties who disagree about a fact write the disagreement as a contingent term each thinks favors it, as buyer and seller who cannot agree on a company's worth sign an earn-out, an insurer and a shipowner who disagree about a hull split the risk by a deductible, two rivals bet on whose method yields more and must run the trial together; the carrier is a difference of belief, the first move is safe because each party expects to win, so the disagreement itself funds the cooperation, and the residue is that whoever measures wins, so the accounting or the trial design becomes the next fight; not impasse-inventions' invented chip, which breaks a deadlock in a negotiation already running, since here there was no relationship and the disagreement is the fuel.

Cargo that rots: one party arrives holding a good that decays faster than a negotiation can run, as a boat with a catch must sell to whoever is on the dock, a grower with fruit at the packing house, a printer with a press idle tonight; the carrier is the good's own clock, the first move is safe for the counterpart because the holder demonstrably cannot play a long game of holding out, and the residue is that the cooperation was priced at duress, the hurried party remembers a hold-up, and the next season opens with a grievance; not impasse-inventions' invented deadline, which is manufactured inside a negotiation, and one side can light this on purpose by choosing to arrive with something that will not keep.

Wall neither can lift: a shared exposure can be reduced only by joint action, as two rowhouse owners with one failing party wall, two farms behind one levee, two tenants over one blocked drain; the carrier is an indivisible physical liability, the first move is safe because contributing to the repair pays the mover in any case and only the other's share is at risk, and the residue is that the cooperation is coextensive with the wall and ends at the repair, so each party either hunts for the next wall or builds one to keep the partner; not the wall one owner can fix alone, which ignites nothing but a sucker, and not the shared enemy, which adapts.

Broker of both names: a third party with history on each side and no stake in the deal beyond its next introduction lends both its name, as a freight broker matches a shipper and a carrier who have never met, a literary agent puts a manuscript in an editor's hands, a Maghribi merchant vouched for an agent overseas; the carrier is a reputation held in the middle, the first move is safe because the broker loses its next match if either side cheats, and the residue is that the parties never build direct trust, the broker sees everything and takes a cut forever, and the first direct deal is the first betrayal; not an enforcer, since the broker can only withhold the next match, and not the bank's letter of credit, where nobody trusts anyone and each party transacts with the bank.

Peace of the fair: a bounded time and ground under a special rule suspends ordinary hostility so strangers can trade, as the medieval fair's peace, the Olympic truce, the Christmas truce of 1914, the trade show floor; the carrier is a calendar and a place, the first move is safe because the suspension is symmetrical and dated and everyone's ordinary state resumes at the bell, and the residue is that nothing done inside travels out, since the peace was the fair's and not the parties', though they leave with a date, the next fair, which is the first shadow of a future; the fair's own court and exclusion from the next fair are its only sanction, so it sits at the edge of the no-enforcer condition, and the truce in the trench had none at all.

residue.item: Open tab: a bartender opens a tab for a stranger so that the debt manufactures a return visit.
residue.why: Merged into Lot you can lose: the bounded loss is the same mechanism, and the return visit it manufactures is a residue of any lot extended on credit rather than a separate ignition.

residue.item: Same village: two strangers who share a hometown cooperate at once because gossip can reach either.
residue.why: Rejected: it imports history through a category, so the ignition is borrowed from the community's record rather than lit between the parties; the map's condition is no shared history, and a shared village is a history with the category.

residue.item: Shared laugh: two strangers who laugh at the same thing have found a common model cheaply.
residue.why: Rejected: it reveals type but makes no first move safe; nothing is put at risk and nothing is left behind, so it is a signal and not an ignition.

residue.item: Ordeal shared: strangers put through the same hardship cooperate afterward.
residue.why: Rejected: a bonding mechanism carried by cooperation-mechanisms' synchronized ritual; the ordeal is imposed on each separately and the cooperation follows it rather than being the first move.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real first deal usually combines several ignitions (a lot, given as a gift, in front of a witness), and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.
The seriation is an itinerary of who can strike the match, not a ranking of strength, cost, or frequency; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (Quaker fixed prices, the fair peace, the 1914 truce, Maghribi agents, Herodotus's silent trade, county barn mutuals) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the silent trade in particular is disputed as history.

The no-enforcer condition is a gradient rather than a line: fairs had courts and brokers can withhold; the map keeps ignitions whose only sanction is withdrawal or exclusion and marks where an item sits at the edge.

What keeps cooperation running once lit is outside the map (cooperation-mechanisms); the residues here name only the ceiling each ignition leaves behind, not its maintenance, and the claim that a staged circumstance inherits the probe's residue is the author's analytical inference.

gaps: The changed question yielded ignitions that abolish the first move: retractable steps (Beach with no faces), a rule addressed to no one (Rule against myself), a price deferred until the thing exists (Price after the crop), a promise free until a state occurs (Promise that costs nothing yet), exit removed by a third (Same cell); and two that shrink it below sight, the self-inflicted cut (First cut) and the planted windfall (Twenty in the till). Sorting all eighteen by who can strike them answered the pointer's live question: the ignitions that fall on both parties (cargo, wall, enemy, cell) each have a deliberate counterfeit one side can stage, and the counterfeit is a probe, so it inherits the probe's residue of secrecy; this became the edge Enemy at both doors → Twenty in the till. The slug cooperation-ignitions stands; the of-sentence now includes who can strike the ignition and the residue it leaves. The standard (container, gauge) did not survive as its own item and lives as the far end of Rule against myself.
accepted: Beach with no faces: the exchange is arranged so that no step requires trusting the next, as in the reported silent trade where traders laid goods on the shore and withdrew, the other side laid gold beside them and withdrew, and the first party took the gold or left it if the pile was short; the carrier is a spatial protocol in which every move is retractable until the last, the first move is safe because at no moment does either party hold both goods, and the residue is that no channel exists, so the parties cannot complain, explain, bundle, or extend credit, and the cooperation cannot grow past spot exchange; Herodotus's account is disputed as history and is kept for the mechanism, which the two-key drop and the escrowed darknet sale reproduce.

Rule against myself: one party binds itself publicly to terms before any stranger arrives, as the Quaker shop posted one price and forswore haggling so a stranger could enter without fear of being fleeced, or a maintainer publishes under a license that cannot be revoked; the carrier is a rule addressed to no one in particular and visible in advance, the first move is safe because the surrendered upside of discretion is repaid by every stranger the rule lets in, and the residue is that the binder can no longer reward a friend, punish a cheat, or price a desperate buyer without breaking the rule that brought the strangers; at its far end lies a rule nobody wrote, the shipping container and the rail gauge, where the addressee is everyone not yet born and the cooperation is exactly as deep as the plug.

Price after the crop: neither party pays until the thing exists, so the price is a share of an output not yet made, as a landlord and a tenant with no history split the harvest, a lawyer takes a stranger's case for a third of the award, an author signs for a royalty; the carrier is the future output itself, the first move is safe because nothing changes hands now and each side risks only its own labor, and the residue is that every input is disputed, since each party bears the whole cost of what it adds and gets half the yield, so the yardstick becomes the second war; not the wager, which needs the parties to disagree, since this works when they agree and simply have no cash and no trust.

Promise that costs nothing yet: each party promises to pay in a state that has not occurred, as farmers in a county pledge to cover any barn that burns or shipowners pledge to share any hull lost; the carrier is a contingency improbable enough that the promise is nearly free to make, the first move is safe because nothing is paid until the loss and every other promiser is still exposed when it comes, and the residue is that the cooperation is untested until the first claim, which is the real ignition and arrives when the promiser is poorest and least willing; not price after the crop, where the trigger is certain and only its size is unknown.

Same cell: two parties are placed together with no exit by a third who did not consult them, as cellmates assigned, conscripts bunked, co-founders who signed one lease, two firms condemned to share one pier; the carrier is an imposed future in which the other cannot disappear, the first move is safe because the shadow of the future is already there without anyone's choosing it, and the residue is that the cooperation is an artifact of the cage and ends at release, since neither party ever chose the other and neither has learned whether it would; not the wall, which is a task, and not the enemy, which has a face; the cage is exit removed and nothing else.

First cut: one party destroys its own outside option in the other's sight, as a tailor cuts the bolt to the stranger's measurements before a deposit is paid or a machine shop tools a die for one customer's part; the carrier is a good made specific to one counterpart and so unsaleable to any other, the first move is safe because the cut is cheap against the job and the customer now knows the tailor cannot walk, and the residue is bilateral monopoly, since the customer can no longer get this coat elsewhere either, so the second negotiation is a hold-up; not a hostage, which is handed to someone, since after the cut nobody holds anything and the loss is simply made.

Twenty in the till: one party stages a windfall the other could keep without being caught, as a bar owner leaves a loose twenty in the drawer on a new bartender's first shift or a jeweler overpays a courier by one stone; the carrier is an apparent error, the first move is safe because the stake is small and its return is uncoerced information, and the residue is that the probe must stay secret forever, since a cooperation later found to have begun as a test reads as contempt; not a gift, which announces itself and makes a debt rather than a reading.

residue.item: Plug for a stranger: conforming to an interface nobody wrote (the container, the gauge) so that cooperation is addressed to every counterpart not yet born.
residue.why: Merged into Rule against myself as its far end: what it lets someone do, cooperate with a stranger who has not arrived, is the same affordance as the posted price, and the only difference, that nobody's promise dies with the shop, is carried in the item's last clause.

residue.item: Announced restraint: one side announces a small unilateral forbearance and invites reciprocation, continuing briefly regardless.
residue.why: Merged into Lot you can lose: an omission is a lot in the currency of forbearance and climbs the same ladder; noted that a first move can be a non-act, which is cheaper to make and harder to prove, but that changes the accounting, not the mechanism.

residue.item: Letter of credit: a bank stands between an exporter and an importer who have never met.
residue.why: Rejected and kept as the boundary case: nobody trusts anyone and each party transacts with the bank, so the deal substitutes for cooperation between the parties rather than igniting it; they may finish still strangers.

residue.item: Shipwreck: strangers cooperate at a common disaster because the loss is imminent for both.
residue.why: Merged into Cargo that rots: the acute shared clock is the same mechanism whether the clock is in the good or in the event, and the difference did not change what either lets someone notice or do; the residue of duress is the same.

checks.boundary_case: A bank's letter of credit between an exporter and an importer who have never met is out: it looks like the cleanest ignition, but the two parties never cooperate with each other at all, since each transacts with the bank, and they may finish the deal still strangers; it substitutes for cooperation rather than igniting it. Broker of both names is in on exactly that contrast, since the broker lends a name the parties must then honor to each other. A court-enforced contract is out for the plainer reason that an enforcer exists.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Lot you can lose two exclusive branches leave on the question of divisibility, to Hostage before the ask when the good is already made and cannot be cut, and to Price after the crop when it can be waited for but not cut. It shows a loop, Promise that costs nothing yet → Lot you can lose, where a free promise only defers the ladder until the first claim, so the mutual ignites twice. It shows an incompatibility between two items that sit apart on the itinerary, Sin in common and Summoned witness, since a cooperation welded to a secret cannot add a public witness without confessing. It shows a passage between levels at Enemy at both doors → Twenty in the till, where any circumstance at the far end of the itinerary, staged by one side, drops to the near end and inherits the probe's secret as its residue, which is the map's answer to which ignitions one side can light. And it shows a second passage at Peace of the fair → Broker of both names, where a recurring truce's host becomes a broker and the fair's toll becomes the broker's permanent cut.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only, pending the independent critic. Each admitted item names a distinct mechanism, a carrier, what makes the first move survivable, and a residue that differs from its neighbors'; the strange members (a windfall planted as a probe, a shore with no faces, a first act that is a sin, a promise free until the barn burns, a tailor's cut as commitment) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about building trust, and the two adjacent lists are answered item by item with what each ignition adds.

next_crossfield_opening: Counterfeit circumstance: connect Twenty in the till with witness-architectures' The hide and cooperative-masks; ask whether every ignition that nobody lights has a staged twin, what the staged twin costs beyond secrecy, and whether a party who suspects staging can test for it without burning the cooperation the staging lit.

Edges relabeled: Lot → Hostage no longer names a single surviving ignition; Lot → Crop drops the exclusivity claim (a merger takes an escrow holdback and an earn-out at once); Enemy → Twenty says the staged circumstance is not a probe but inherits the probe's residue exactly and must go on feeding its enemy. The critic's seed on custom is left here rather than in boundary_claim, which already holds five limits and the seed is an opening, not a limit.
seed: The customary ignition. Several of these mechanisms have been lit so often in one trade that nobody lights them any more: the trial load is what freight is, the honesty shop is what retail does, the fair recurs until it is a market. Each time an ignition becomes custom it migrates along the itinerary from 'one hand, aimed' to 'nobody lights it', and it sheds its residue as it goes (the twenty stops being a secret, the lot's trial price stops reading as betrayal, the fair's peace becomes the exchange's rulebook). That is a passage the map does not contain: custom as a Rule against myself lit by the whole trade at once, and a second map of which ignitions each trade has institutionalized, what residue institutionalization removed, and which residue it cannot remove (the broker's cut, the wall's end at the repair). The ledger's own next opening, whether a party who suspects staging can test for it without burning the cooperation, is the same seed from the other side, since the cheapest test for staging is to ask whether the circumstance is one the trade lights for everyone.
